text:
nora: Quick sync — we need a concrete migration/playbook for shipping multi-precision profiles (fp8/int8/4bit). Want low-risk rollout and clear observability.
chris: Agreed. My top concerns: silent quality drift, per-shard variability, and operator ergonomics.
jules: Can we define an immutable profile artifact that bundles quant params + calibration checksum + rollout metadata? runtime just consumes artifact id.
anita: Yes. artifact should be content-addressed (sha256) so mismatches are obvious. Also include a compact header for runtime: format version, model id, intended seq-length buckets.
nora: Example header sketch (pseudo):
```
artifact_header: {"ver":"1", "model":"rw-13b", "buckets":["0-128","129-512","512+"] , "calib_sha":"..."}
```
chris: We need sequence-aware routing in edge cases. Short seqs are resilient to fp8 noise; long seqs amplify errors. Suggest policy: map bucket -> preferred format, but allow runtime to fall back per-layer if activation histograms show saturation.
jules: Runtime will need a cheap runtime check: if top-k activation percentile > X then switch that layer to higher-precision. That check must be O(1) per layer sample, not expensive.
anita: Ops wants these tags emitted: quant.artifact_id, quant.bucket, quant.layer_fallbacks, quant.switch_reason. Hook them to traces and metrics.
devops-bot: NOTICE: rollout clusters must enable tracing and tag: rollout:quant-v1.
chris: How do we quantify acceptable loss? absolute perplexity delta is noisy across workloads. Propose two-tier signals: 1) global sentinel eval set (relative delta threshold) 2) customer-specific golden prompts (if pinned).
nora: +1. For global sentinel, use relative perplexity < 1.2% OR task f1 drop < 0.8%. If either fails, trigger automated pause.
jules: Also capture per-shard variance: if 95th percentile of per-shard delta > 2x median, flag for investigation (could be weight shard alignment or quant table mismatch).
anita: For safety, implement a conservative auto-fallback: on any "token_mismatch_rate" > 0.5% for 10k tokens, upgrade affected session to float16 and mark artifact unhealthy.
chris: Ops playbook snippet to triage regressions:
```
1) identify artifact_id and shards involved.
2) run local reproducer with same seed + artifact.
3) check activation percentile heatmap for failing examples.
4) toggle per-layer format in binary profile to isolate layer.
5) if unresolved, revert service traffic to previous artifact and open incident.
```
nora: We should keep the first pilot internal only (no customer pinning) and one model. Limit to shadow -> 1% shadow sampling -> 5% canary -> 20% canary -> full.
anj: (typo)
chris: Also add metrics: quant.switch_count, quant.fallback_count, quant.artifact_health{healthy|degraded}. Make dashboards: artifact drift over time, per-bucket perplexity delta.
jules: Registry thoughts: immutable artifacts, tags for "canary:bool" and "pinned_by_customer:" list. Pinning requires signed manifest and custodian approval (audit trail).
anita: For storage use compact protobuf + zstd for runtime blob; provide human-readable JSON for review. Runtime should verify calib_sha on load.
devops-bot: ACTION: when creating rollout config, include: trace=on, sample_rate, eval_hooks=enabled.
nora: Action items: 
- nora: draft artifact header & schema (human JSON + runtime proto) by Tue EOD
- chris: propose sentinel eval set + thresholds by Wed
- jules: sketch registry + pinning workflow by Thu
- anita: add tracing tags + metric names to ops playbook by Fri
- devops-bot: will auto-post rollout checklist to #eng-ml when available

nora: Thanks — want to avoid stealth regressions. Keep notes tight and we'll iterate on schema in PR. :rocket:
